name: Suspicious Persistence Via VMwareToolBoxCmd.EXE VM State Change Script
description: Detects execution of the "VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe" with the "script" and "set" flag to setup a specific script that's located in a potentially suspicious location to run for a specific VM state
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:toolbox\-cmd.exe) AND (process.command_line:*\ script\ * AND process.command_line:*\ set\ *) AND (process.command_line:(*\:\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\:\\Temp\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Tasks\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp*))
